propositions: close_precheck._completion_precheck derives code_root from os.path.dirname(tracker) instead of explicit repository context, causing git log to scan the tracker parent instead of the current code worktree
CLI transition close --ref HEAD falsely reports no referencing commit when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is out-of-worktree, even when a trailer exists in the current code checkout
The defect causes either false rejection of valid referencing commits or silent gate bypass depending on tracker parent file presence
code_root must be resolved via config.repo_root(repo_root) consistently for referencing commit checks and completion-gate configuration to match the caller's current worktree HEAD
Default in-repo tracker behavior and true missing-commit failures must remain unchanged after the fix
